title: The Caliph Hisham and the Arab Youth
logline: A caliph out hunting barks at a shepherd boy without a greeting; the boy answers him back, is sentenced to death, and laughs his way to freedom with a tale of a hawk and a sparrow.
moral: Good manners bind kings too, and a calm, clever word can turn away a ruler's anger.
tone: Light court comedy with one stretch of real suspense: pompous caliph on a high horse, an unshakeable boy, nervous attendants, no blood.

beats.summary: Caliph Hisham hunts a gazelle and outruns his companions.
He meets a shepherd boy and asks the way from the saddle.
No greeting: he orders the boy like a servant.
The boy stands and asks whether speech has no manners, even for a king.
Hisham rages and pulls rank; the boy answers that rank excuses nobody.
The men arrive; the boy is seized and the executioner called.
The executioner asks once, twice, three times; the hand does not fall.
His tale: the hawk, the sparrow and the tiny meal.
The question is put to the caliph; silence.
Freed, and his mouth filled with jewels.
He leaves alive and honoured; the caliph greets first this time.

The planned open grazing meadow, 1600 x 1230, ground y 900, here near the hills: Library sky (day), sun at (1350, 170), two cloudFlat, a band of bare rounded hills in tan with red dot shading across the back (crests y 560..700), Library ground. Anchors: sitting rock at x 600 (140 wide, flat top y 852); acacia style Library tree() at x 1120; grass tufts; a dotted footpath leaving left toward the hills for the exit.

props.description: Guard spear: brown shaft 250 long, 8 wide, yellow leaf blade 36 long, red tassel that lags.
The planned sword (AN-082) as a curved scimitar 170 long with a glint; carried on the shoulder or held upright, never swung.
Greeting pictogram 90 px: an open white hand laid over a red heart inside a yellow disc with a black brush ring. States: pop, struck through with a red X, fallen (tilted on the ground), glint.
Cut gems (red, blue, green, yellow; 5 facet polygons 18..34 px with a white glint) plus a small casket (jewelBox 110 x 80, lid open 0..1).

actions.acting: boy cheeks puffed (two more gems behind the first), eyes wide with delight
actions.library: PERSON_HANDS.reachBoth + jewels {n 8} falling with fallY() and rebound()

actions.action: ties the gems into his head cloth corner and takes the big gem out of his mouth to say thank you, hand on chest
actions.acting: smile, small bow

actions.action: turns and walks left, staff in hand; the lamb trots to him, the sheep fall in behind one by one
actions.acting: light step, head up
actions.library: walk() + footfalls(); sheep walk() with stagger; turnFlip not needed (front facing figure, flip dir)

actions.action: calls after him and, this time, greets first: hand flat on his chest, head bowed
actions.acting: the payoff of the whole film: warm brow, smile; the greeting icon pops over his hand

actions.action: stops, turns, returns the greeting with his hand on his chest, then waves
actions.acting: both icons glint together; the guards copy the gesture a beat late

actions.action: pull out wide and pan left with the boy and flock walking toward the hills
actions.acting: caliph group small on the right, remounting; the boy shadow long

actions.action: walks on, tossing the big gem once and catching it
actions.acting: gaze follows the gem up and down
actions.library: fallY()/hop arc for the gem + gaze plan

actions.action: a real sparrow flutters down and lands on the top of his staff; he looks up at it and smiles
actions.acting: sparrow landSquash, quick head turns; boy gaze up

actions.action: THE END title in the sky; the sparrow chirps once, the flock keeps walking in place toward the hills
actions.acting: held ending, small life only: blinks, sheep tails, sun rays

ending.description: After the last word (167.82) the boy and his flock walk on toward the hills with a sparrow on his staff; the caliph's party is small on the right. THE END is held from 168.0 to 171.1 with a single quiet chime at 168.3.

subtitles.ar: خرج الخليفة هشام يومًا للصيد،|وابتعد عن أصحابه وهو يطارد غزالًا.|وفي الطريق رأى فتى من أهل البادية يرعى غنمه قرب التلال،|فتوقف أمامه وسأله عن الطريق.
subtitles.en: One day Caliph Hisham went hunting|and rode away from his companions while pursuing a gazelle.|He stopped beside a young shepherd|and asked for directions.

subtitles.ar: لكن الخليفة لم يبدأ بالسلام،|بل كلم الفتى بصوت آمر كأنه يأمر أحد خدمه.|رفع الفتى رأسه وقال بشجاعة:|ألا تعرف أن للكلام أدبًا، حتى إذا كان قائله ملكًا؟
subtitles.en: Hisham did not greet him.|He spoke as if ordering a servant.|The boy looked up and boldly asked|whether a king, too, should not speak with courtesy.

subtitles.ar: غضب هشام من جرأته، وقال إنه أمير المؤمنين، وإن على الفتى أن يعرف مقامه.|أجابه الفتى بأن المكانة لا تمنع الإنسان من حسن الخلق،|وأن التحية حق لكل من يلقاه.
subtitles.en: Hisham angrily declared that he was the caliph.|The youth replied that high position did not excuse bad manners|and that everyone deserved a greeting.

subtitles.ar: وصل رجال الخليفة في تلك اللحظة،|فأمر هشام أن يمسكوا بالفتى.|ثم دعا الجلاد وطلب إليه قتله.|وقف الفتى ثابتًا، بينما أخذ الجلاد ينتظر إشارة التنفيذ أمام الحاضرين.
subtitles.en: The caliph’s men arrived.|Hisham had the youth seized|and ordered an executioner to kill him.|The young shepherd stood firm as the executioner awaited the signal.

subtitles.ar: سأل الجلاد الخليفة مرة، ثم ثانية، ثم ثالثة: هل أنفذ الأمر؟|وفي كل مرة ظل الفتى هادئًا.|ثم ضحك فجأة،|فتعجب هشام وسأله كيف يضحك وهو قريب من الموت.
subtitles.en: The executioner asked three times whether to carry out the order.|The boy remained calm,|then suddenly laughed.|Hisham demanded to know why he laughed so near death.

subtitles.ar: قال الفتى: سمعت عن صقر أمسك عصفورًا صغيرًا.|فقال له العصفور: ماذا تنتفع بلقمة صغيرة مثلي؟ لن أشبع جوعك.|ففكر الصقر في كلامه، ثم فتح مخالبه وتركه يطير.
subtitles.en: The boy told of a hawk that caught a little sparrow.|The sparrow asked what use such a tiny meal could be.|The hawk considered the question and released it.

subtitles.ar: ثم نظر الفتى إلى هشام وقال: وأنت أيضًا ملك عظيم،|فماذا يزيد سلطانك إذا قتلت راعيًا فقيرًا؟|سكت الحاضرون،|ثم انفجر الخليفة ضاحكًا من جواب الفتى وذكائه وشجاعته.
subtitles.en: The youth then asked what a mighty ruler|could gain by killing a poor shepherd.|The court fell silent;|Hisham burst out laughing at the boy’s wit and courage.

subtitles.ar: أمر هشام بإطلاق سراحه،|وطلب أن توضع في فمه جواهر ثمينة مكافأة له.|خرج الفتى حيًا مكرمًا|بعدما واجه غضب الخليفة بكلمات واضحة وقصة عصفور صغير.
subtitles.en: Hisham ordered his release|and had precious jewels placed in his mouth as a reward.|The boy left alive and honored,|having faced the ruler’s anger with a sparrow’s story.

new_assets.name: horse
new_assets.description: Side view riding horse for any rider story (kings, messengers, hunters). About 400 wide x 330 tall at s 1: back top 215 above the feet, head top 330. Fields: ph, amp (walk and trot), gallop 0..1 (front and rear pairs reach together with an air phase), brake 0..1 (front legs braced, haunches down), raise (front hoof), headDown 0..1 (graze), headTurn, ears -1..1, snort, tailSwish, mane lag, saddle:true, pal. Returns saddle point for a rider.
new_assets.implementation: Copy the Library deer structure (rounded box body 250 x 120, four two-segment legs driven by ph and amp, neck as a tapered quad, head 120 x 62 with a long muzzle). Mane and tail are brush stroke fans with 3 frame lag via delayed position. Wrap with acting() for gaze, lid, sq, tip. Rider: draw the far leg, the horse, then person {sit:1, seat:'bench'} at the saddle point with a bob delayed 2 frames.

new_assets.name: person costume presets (guard, executioner)
new_assets.description: Two presets on the person costume layer. guard: short tunic, sash, pointed helmet with neck cloth, moustache optional. executioner: sleeveless jerkin (bare skin sleeves), wide sash, head wrap, broad shoulders (+12 %), heavy lid default 0.4.
new_assets.implementation: Add two rows to the COSTUME table in cast/people.js (palettes and headwear); helmet is a half ellipse plus a triangle point and a rectangle cloth; the wrap is the turban shape flattened. No change to existing presets (regression stays identical).

new_assets.name: person youth option
new_assets.description: Opt-in youth:true: a teenager between child and adult: no facial hair, head 1.1x, used with s about 0.84.
new_assets.implementation: One branch beside the existing child option in cast/people.js: skip beard and moustache, scale the head group 1.1 about the neck.

new_assets.name: sheep
new_assets.description: The planned background sheep (about 190 x 150 at s 1) with ph, amp, headDown, chew, hop, plus headTurn; lamb = s 0.55.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by AN-040: wool as a ring of overlapping circles on a rounded body, black face wedge, four stick legs driven by walk().

new_assets.name: hawk (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The planned bird of prey kind on the Library bird, with one extra opt-in field talon 0..1 (claws closed to spread) and the planned carry option.
new_assets.implementation: New entry in the BIRD palette table plus hooked beak path and brow bar; talons as three short tapered strokes per foot rotating open with the talon field.

new_assets.name: sparrow (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The planned sparrow kind on the Library bird, pal 0.
new_assets.implementation: Palette entry and bib shape on the Library bird; no crest.

new_assets.name: pasture
new_assets.description: The planned 1600 wide meadow, here with a hill band, a sitting rock (x 600, top y 852) and one tree (x 1120).
new_assets.implementation: bake(): sky(), sun(), cloudFlat(), hills as 5 overlapping ellipses with K dot shading, ground(), tree(), rock as a rounded polygon with a brush outline.

new_assets.name: chaseRoad
new_assets.description: The planned loop strip for the hunt, steppe palette.
new_assets.implementation: Two baked layers drawn twice with modulo offsets from the travelled distance (hills 0.3, ground 1.0).

new_assets.name: jewels (with jewelBox)
new_assets.description: Cut gems in four colours and a small casket with a hinged lid; used with the planned goldGlow.
new_assets.implementation: Each gem a 5 point polygon with two facet lines and a glint; casket two rounded boxes, the lid rotating about the back edge.

new_assets.name: greetingIcon
new_assets.description: Hand over heart pictogram with pop, X, fallen and glint states: the film's running sign for the missing and finally given greeting.
new_assets.implementation: Disc, Library heart(), a mitten hand polygon; X = two brush strokes; states by parameters.

new_assets.name: spear, sword
new_assets.description: Guard spear and the planned sword as a scimitar.
new_assets.implementation: Flat shapes attached at P.hands of the carrier; tassel lags by sampling the hand position 3 frames earlier.

new_assets.name: person mouthItem
new_assets.description: Opt-in field mouthItem: draws a small callback (here a gem) held between the teeth of an open grin, with cheeks 0..1 puff.
new_assets.implementation: After the mouth is drawn, call P.mouthItem(ctx) at the mouth centre; cheeks = two small arcs outside the mouth corners.

owner_questions: The execution threat is shown without violence: the sword rests on the shoulder or is held upright and is never raised over the boy, and there is no blood (default: softened as described).
The jewels in the mouth are staged as comedy: one big gem popped between his teeth and the rest poured into his hands (default: this comic version rather than a mouth crammed full).
An unscripted payoff is added at 159.3: the caliph greets the boy first with his hand on his chest and the boy returns it (default: keep it, no words added).
The caliph rides a horse and gets down from it off screen at 43.3; his companions (a vizier and two guards) follow on foot (default: one horse only, to keep new assets modest).
Invented comic lettering: WAIT FOR US!, YOU! BOY!, I AM THE CALIPH!, HA HA!, ?!, BAA, HA HA HA!, FREE! (default: keep all eight plus THE END).
No LATER card is used because the whole story happens in one continuous meeting (default: none).
A real sparrow lands on the boy staff at the last words as a closing image (default: keep it).
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; LIFE.t = t each frame for auto blinks; set noBlink during the two held silences (81.2 to 83.4 and 139.1 to 140.8).
Word cues with w(p, n) from timing.json; every action cue in this plan is a start time from timeline.md. The three counts use countedBeats([86.2, 87.8, 89.26]).
One blocking table for S5 to S8 (boy 600, guards 520 and 690, executioner 800, caliph 980 or 860, vizier 1120, horse 1300) so cuts never jump positions.

The person figure is front facing: show who addresses whom with gaze (lookAt), tip and arm angles; use aL/aR angles for the big readable shapes (signal hand, rank high and low, pointing at the crown).
The signal hand is one keyed value H(t): 1.0 from 73.4, 0.85 at 87.8, 0.65 at 89.26, 0 at 98.04. Draw the dashed drop line only 79.6 to 96.

Story cloud S7: thoughtCloud with inside(c, t) drawing its own pale sky and a branch; keep the hawk about 190 px and the sparrow about 70 px on screen; the exit of the sparrow is drawn twice (inside clip until the edge, then in the world) with a cut over at the cloud border.
Dismount is hidden by the cut at 43.3; the horse then idles (headDown graze cycle, tail swish) at x 1100, moved to 1300 in S5.
Sound: only the listed effects, in the listed pauses, master 0.6; nothing between 90.56 and 167.82 except the tick at 90.25. Laughs are lettering and acting only.
Panel-only shake is not needed; the executioner steps use a 2 px panel bump at most.
Call finish last; subtitles from the subtitles array of this plan (verbatim, checked by program).
warnings: The horse is the one large new drawing (effort L); if time is short it can be reduced to walk, gallop and brake only.
The person figure has no profile and no real mounting pose: the rider is the seated pose placed on the saddle, so check the leg overlap on the horse flank in a still before animating.

Six human figures share the frame in S5 to S8; at zoom 0.95 each is about 215 px tall on screen, so keep lettering and labels out of the head band (y 640..760) and check phone legibility with a contact sheet.

Hawk and sparrow kinds, sheep, pasture, chaseRoad, sword, flush, featherFall, goldGlow and iconBalloon are planned assets that may not exist in Library yet; build whichever are missing in the story and move them to Library after approval.
No LATER transition is used (continuous time); plancheck reports this as a warning.
